title: A Day at the Playground
text:
Tom likes the playground. In spring, the trees are green and the flowers are pretty. Today it is sunny and warm, so Tom goes to the park with his dad. He plays on the slide and the swing.

In autumn, the leaves on the trees are red and yellow. The playground is wet and cold when it rains. Tom likes to jump in the big piles of leaves. Then he and his dad go home and drink hot tea.

questions.text: Who goes to the park with Tom?
What does Tom like to jump in?
How does Tom probably feel about the playground?
options: He does not want to go

questions.text: Why do Tom and his dad drink hot tea at home?
options: It is cold and wet outside

vocabulary.definition: a place outside with equipment where children play
a seat hung on ropes that moves back and forth
the flat green or colored parts that grow on trees

paragraph_translations: Tom lubi plac zabaw. Wiosną drzewa są zielone, a kwiaty ładne. Dzisiaj jest słonecznie i ciepło, więc Tom idzie do parku ze swoim tatą. Bawi się na zjeżdżalni i na huśtawce.
Jesienią liście na drzewach są czerwone i żółte. Plac zabaw jest mokry i zimny, kiedy pada deszcz. Tom lubi skakać w dużych stosach liści. Potem on i jego tata wracają do domu i piją gorącą herbatę.
